ITEM.PTXT: With the power (ACC or IG) ON, operating the volume adjustment buttons ("Up" or "Down" buttons) allows the volume of the voice guidance from the ETC unit to be adjusted (8 levels) or muted. If no voice guidance is in progress, the voice guidance "Volume *" or "Voice guidance will be stopped" is given; if some voice guidance is in progress, the current voice guidance is repeated at the adjusted volume so that the volume can be checked.
Even when voice guidance is stopped, guidance is given at volume 1 when an error occurs.
